source: Funston et al. 2026, Nature Communications, Fig. 4a: Bayesian (FBD-scaled) phylogeny of Oviraptorosauria; vertical, root at the bottom, tips at the top with rotated labels, a stage column at the left, a shaded 'Rise of Fruit' band, numbered node arrows (1-3), Oviraptoridae as a black wedge, dentary drawings. Panels b and c (plots) are excluded. Image: census figure (2000x1247 px).
region_note: panel a (the phylogeny); b and c are plots

names_note: no matrix held; list = the printed tip names ('Avimimus spp.' and 'Caudipteryx spp.' as printed; Oviraptoridae is a collapsed clade drawn as a wedge)
gold_note: Oviraptorosaur time tree, vertical. 'Avimimus spp.' labels a two-branch fork with one name; it is encoded as one tip, as are 'Caudipteryx spp.' and the Oviraptoridae wedge. Eucaenagnathinae is printed under its node and kept as an internal label; the numbered arrows 1-3 mark nodes without names and are not encoded. 19 tips, fully resolved; 1 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Random-sample case (seed 20261114). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
